verdict.rationale: The product is itself a built-in, always-on agent. Users can hand it tasks: you keep talking to it while it works, it runs background agents in parallel, sub-delegates to ChatGPT Work or Codex, and performs scheduled and recurring tasks across connected apps and its own cloud computer. Delegated work can be inspected in Activity and governed through rules, permissions, take-over and pause controls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as documented, since all evidence is vendor docs.
